$comment: Dependency manifest for cross-compiling UltraCanvas's rendering stack to
Each entry is a pkg_check_modules call in UltraCanvas/CMakeLists.txt.
libvips is one of them: it is part of UltraCanvas on every platform, with
the codecs the desktop pipeline reads and writes (JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF),
EXIF and colour management, GIF (read: libvips' built-in decoder) and Netpbm;
GIF is written by the framework's own saver, ICO and QOI by the framework's
plug-ins. Deliberately absent: librsvg (Rust + gobject; SVG goes through
the core's vector renderer), GTK3/X11 (never referenced by the Android
platform arm), GStreamer (video uses the NDK's MediaCodec). See
name: ultracanvas-android

net.description: UltraNet support (-DULTRACANVAS_ENABLE_NET=ON). c-ares is mandatory on Android: bionic exports no res_n* API, so the per-platform DNS fallback cannot build.
